title: COMPLETE says where its time went
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY to the gateway that ran the runs and FARMSLOT_COMPLETE_TIMING_RUN_IDS to space-separated finished run IDs (at least one fix-bug or dev run whose slot was released). Read-only: one run.get per run. Against a gateway without the phase timers the timing assertion fails; against one with them, each COMPLETE records its phases, bundle-lock wait and hold, and processes, and each run records its slot release duration.

proofTargets.claim: A finished run's COMPLETE outputs carry per-phase wall time and its run-bundle lock wait and hold.
A run whose slot was released records the release duration on the run.

read.intent: Read each run through run.get and check its COMPLETE timing and slot release record.

timed.intent: Every run checked has COMPLETE timing and a timed release.
